questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I think the level of the two courses I took was very different

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: 15 points for each course. The first one was very difficult while the second one was so easy. I didn't even read the book in the second class and still got an A. The first course was all about what was in the book..

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: At home its easy to spot the difference between seminars and lectures. In Stockholm, the difference was that you should be prepared for the seminars. They were also mandatory to attend.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
International criminal law
International commersial dispute resolutions

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: International commercial dispute resolutions. It was so much fun and a part of the exam was mediation and mock arbitration

questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: People are kind and I understand them. They love Danish people and Copenhagen haha

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be open-minded, don't worry you will make friends, take it chill and enjoy your time

questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: How I improved my spoken English. I was so nervous to speak out loud before the exchange. Now I feel much more safe.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The language. Both Swedish and English
